title: National Works on Paper 2026 (NWOP)
summary: One of Australia's leading art awards and exhibitions. $20000 major acquisitive prize. Survey of contemporary art celebrating the medium of paper in all its forms – prints, drawings, collage, mixed media. Open Tue–Sun 11am–4pm. Free entry. Opening event with prize announcement.
